home.title: NYU Shanghai Robotics Club
home.lead: We design, build and drive our own robots, and take them to competition.
home.body1: The club is open to every year and every major. Half of us are mechanical, electrical or software; the other half run media, marketing and logistics. Both halves are needed to get a robot to the field.
home.body2: We compete in VEX U and in DJI's RoboMaster University League. Between competitions we run workshops and take on projects of our own.
home.recordNote: Every award the club has won. Newest first.
home.joinBody: We recruit at the start of each semester. No experience required — just show up to a build session.
home.posterAlt: NYU Shanghai Robotics Club recruitment poster

about.title: About the club
about.lead: A student-run robotics club at NYU Shanghai.
about.missionBody: We build competition robots. Students design the mechanics, wire the electronics and write the control software, then test it against other universities. Alongside the competition work we run workshops and talks that are open to the whole campus.
about.structureBody: The club is run by a student board and split into working groups: programming, mechanical, software, research and development, marketing and media. Anyone can join any group — there is no application and no prerequisite.
about.contactBody: For sponsorship, collaboration or anything else, email the club and a board member will get back to you.

robomaster.title: RoboMaster
robomaster.lead: Our RoboMaster squad builds a full robot fleet for DJI's university league.
robomaster.intro1: RoboMaster is DJI's university robotics competition. Teams build a fleet of robots — infantry, hero, sentry, engineer — and fight 3v3 in an arena where engineering quality decides the match.
robomaster.intro2: United Force competes in the RoboMaster University League. In the 2026 season we fielded infantry, hero and sentry robots at the Jiangsu Station, held at the Jiangyin Gymnasium over three days in March.
robomaster.resultsNote: Three awards from the Jiangsu Station of the RoboMaster 2026 University League.
